moments.text: Infrared view of open sea, darker around the crosshair, black redaction boxes. Brief grey blank frames recur throughout the clip.
A small white dot rises from the bottom edge, left of centre, then slides to the left edge.
As the view swings to follow, the dot sweeps right across the lower half, back left, then in toward the crosshair.
The dot stays near the crosshair, drifting up toward the top around 26 s and back down.
A teal box appears around the crosshair, a black redaction block at its right; the dot moves into the box.
The box shrinks to small teal brackets locked on the dot just below the crosshair centre.
A bright, grainy contrast window opens around the crosshair; the bracketed dot stays inside it.
The window and brackets vanish and the dot can no longer be seen; the view keeps changing zoom and contrast, with brief blanks.
